note: Both delivered editions are listed as source editions, so only the named edition that is not delivered can make the entry stale.
fails_if: `compile_edition_splits` accepts a split whose named edition the native variant does not deliver, instead of reporting it stale

sources.description: Variant 2 of register 1 delivers SHARED (variable 5) twice for 2007: edition '2007' (CVID 20, integer) and edition '2007-12-31' (CVID 21, string).
